provenance.dataGenerationMethod: DICOM medical imaging from diagnostic radiology department. Images captured using Siemens SOMATOM Definition AS+ CT scanner and GE Revolution EVO CT system. Standardized acquisition protocols following ACR guidelines.
provenance.dataFormat: DICOM (original), PNG (processed for ML, 512x512 pixels, 8-bit grayscale)
provenance.dataSubjectivity: Subjective - radiologist diagnoses and annotations represent expert clinical interpretation, validated by consensus of 3 board-certified radiologists with 10+ years experience

qualityIndicators.missingData: 0.3% of cases excluded due to motion artifacts

dataProcessingSteps: DICOM to PNG conversion with normalization
De-identification: removal of all PHI metadata from DICOM headers
Quality control: automated detection and exclusion of motion artifacts

use.intendedUse: Training and validation of machine learning models for automated pneumonia detection in chest X-rays. Intended for research and educational purposes to advance medical AI diagnostics.
use.restrictions: Research and educational use only. Not approved for clinical deployment without additional validation and FDA clearance. Commercial use requires separate licensing agreement with General Hospital.
use.legalRightsToUse: Institutional Review Board (IRB) approved under protocol #2022-ML-001. Patient consent obtained for research use of de-identified medical data. HIPAA compliant under Safe Harbor de-identification method.
use.privacyMeasures: Full de-identification per HIPAA Safe Harbor: all 18 identifiers removed including patient names, dates (converted to year only), geographic identifiers, device IDs, and biometric identifiers. Expert determination confirmed re-identification risk < 0.01%.
use.dataProcessingLocation: US-based secure compute environment (AWS us-east-1), HIPAA-compliant infrastructure, encrypted at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.3)

_comments.why_this_matters: Medical imaging requires strict privacy compliance (HIPAA), clear documentation of data quality for FDA approval pathways, and transparent provenance for clinical validation studies.
_comments.key_challenges: Balancing data utility with privacy protection, maintaining image quality during processing, ensuring representative geographic and demographic distribution
_comments.regulatory_context: FDA guidance on AI/ML-based medical devices requires comprehensive data provenance documentation for premarket submissions
